sources.title: What is a generative model? - IBM
sources.snippet: What is a generative model? A generative model is a machine learning model designed to create new data that is similar to its training data. Generative artificial intelligence (AI) models learn the patterns and distributions of the training data, then apply those understandings to generate novel content in response to new input data.

sources.title: What are Generative AI Models? - Generative AI Models Explained - AWS
sources.snippet: Thousands of proprietary and open-source AI models exist, and new models and improved versions are being released daily. Despite their flexibility and versatility, generative AI models are not a catch-all solution for every use case. AI teams must carefully select and evaluate the best model that optimizes cost and performance.
